extraction.name: Arabic-Nougat: Fine-Tuning Vision Transformers for Arabic OCR and Markdown Extraction
extraction.description: We introduce Arabic-Nougat, a suite of OCR models designed to convert Arabic book pages into structured Markdown text. Building on Meta's Nougat architecture, Arabic-Nougat includes three specialized models: arabic-small-nougat, arabic-base-nougat, and arabic-large-nougat. These models are fine-tuned using a synthetic dataset, arabic-img2md, consisting of 13.7k paired samples of Arabic book pages and their Markdown representations.
extraction.creator: Mohamed A. Rashad
extraction.citeAs: Mohamed A. Rashad. (2024). Arabic-Nougat: Fine-Tuning Vision Transformers for Arabic OCR and Markdown Extraction. arXiv:2411.17835v1.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The primary dataset used for training, arabic-img2md, contains 13.7k paired samples of Arabic book pages and their Markdown representations. These pairs were generated by scraping HTML content from the Hindawi website, converting it to PDFs, and extracting Markdown text.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: HTML content scraped from the Hindawi website.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: HTML content was converted to PDFs, and Markdown text was extracted.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The arabic-img2md dataset, derived from Hindawi's web content, may not generalize well to other domains of Arabic text, such as scientific, religious, or historical documents.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Hallucination in arabic-small-nougat; repetition in larger models; dataset biases; scalability challenges; cross-script generalization not extensively tested; complex layouts may require additional preprocessing.
